value="<b>Numbered request path</b><br>① Browser → CloudFront over HTTPS (TLS terminates at the edge).<br>② CloudFront → ALB over HTTP:80; ALB security group admits only the AWS-managed<br> prefix list com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing.<br>③ ALB → API task :8000 (api-sg admits only alb-sg).<br>④ API → RDS with sslmode=require; authorization predicate runs inside every query.<br>⑤ Worker relays the transactional outbox to SQS and consumes jobs (≤ 2 concurrent).<br>⑥ Worker calls Bedrock Converse; a deterministic validator checks every answer." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="150" width="720" x="470" y="900" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c44" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;strokeColor=#879196;fillColor=#F7F8F8;fontColor=#232F3E;dashed=0;fontSize=10;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;fontStyle=0;" value="<b>All tasks</b> pull the image from ECR, receive DB credentials from Secrets<br>Manager at start, and ship logs to CloudWatch. Egress to AWS APIs uses task<br>public IPs through the IGW (no NAT, no VPC endpoints: ~$0 fixed network cost).<br>API role: S3 only. Worker role: SQS + 2 Bedrock models. No role can approve<br>proposals except via the API's DB role." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="500" x="1240" y="925" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
Numbered request path
① Browser → CloudFront over HTTPS (TLS terminates at the edge).
② CloudFront → ALB over HTTP:80; ALB security group admits only the AWS-managed
prefix list com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing.
③ ALB → API task :8000 (api-sg admits only alb-sg).
④ API → RDS with sslmode=require; authorization predicate runs inside every query.
⑤ Worker relays the transactional outbox to SQS and consumes jobs (≤ 2 concurrent).
⑥ Worker calls Bedrock Converse; a deterministic validator checks every answer.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 486px; height: 1px; padding-top: 926px; margin-left: 1246px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #232F3E;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#232F3E, #bdc7d4); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
All tasks pull the image from ECR, receive DB credentials from Secrets
Manager at start, and ship logs to CloudWatch. Egress to AWS APIs uses task
public IPs through the IGW (no NAT, no VPC endpoints: ~$0 fixed network cost).
API role: S3 only. Worker role: SQS + 2 Bedrock models. No role can approve
proposals except via the API's DB role.
